subject: general
question:
The sales of three companies X, Y and Z in different years are shown in the following graph. Study the graph and answer the question.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ab166276e30071c3a3fbd3370937192c49efdf2e2d03247ab875fcebd45282e2.png] 

Which company has the highest total sales for the period from year 1996 to 1998? By what percentage is the sales of company Z more than company Y in the year 1997?
solution:
**Given:**

Sales data for Companies X, Y, and Z from 1996 to 1998.

**Calculations:**

 
• 
 
**Total Sales for each company (1996-1998):**

 
 
• Company X: 40 + 55 + 45 = 140
 
• Company Y: 60 + 50 + 55 = 165
 
• Company Z: 50 + 60 + 60 = 170
 
 
 
• 
 
**Percentage difference in sales between Z and Y in 1997:**

 
 
• Sales of Company Z in 1997: 60
 
• Sales of Company Y in 1997: 50
 

 
Difference in sales = 60 - 50 = 10

 
Percentage increase = (Difference / Sales of Company Y) * 100 = (10 / 50) * 100 = 20%

 

**Therefore:**

** Company Z has the highest total sales for the period 1996 to 1998.**

** The sales of Company Z are 20% more than Company Y in the year 1997.**
